find: valid_host "$front_host" || refuse "--host must be a plain DNS hostname"
why: hostnames with spaces, newlines, or shell metacharacters must be refused

find: valid_target "$tailnet_target" || refuse "--tailnet-target must be an IP literal"
why: the Control Room backend must be a literal Tailscale address

find: valid_cidr "$source" || refuse "--allow-source must be an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR"
why: allow-list entries must not inject HAProxy directives
the Mac must receive the client address through PROXY protocol v2

find: tcp-request content reject if control_room_sni { sc0_conn_cur gt 20 }
replace: tcp-request content reject if control_room_sni { sc0_conn_cur gt 200 }
why: Control Room concurrent connections must remain capped at twenty per source

find: tcp-request content reject if control_room_sni { sc0_conn_rate gt 60 }
replace: tcp-request content reject if control_room_sni { sc0_conn_rate gt 600 }
why: Control Room connection creation must remain capped at sixty per minute per source

find: printf '\n  tcp-request content reject if control_room_sni !control_room_source_allowed\n'
why: a configured source allow-list must actually refuse other Control Room sources

find: if [ -n "$disable_old_serve" ]; then tailscale serve reset >/dev/null; fi
why: the old Serve configuration may change only after the explicit flag
a failed post-change website probe must trigger rollback
a second caller must be refused rather than wait and mutate after the first

find: same_install || refuse "a different front-door installation already exists; remove it first"
why: idempotency must not accept changed install arguments
dry-run must return before any mutation
generated accept ports must not contradict the fixed deny tests
